economic_rationale: VIX measures expected US equity volatility and is a common global risk-aversion proxy. It affects crypto through deleveraging, liquidity demand, and broad risk appetite.
selected_orientation_note: The selected empirical gate treats higher VIX levels as favourable. This should not be read as a general claim that high VIX is always good for crypto; it may capture rebound windows when stress is elevated but no longer worsening.

economic_rationale: Short-term VIX changes capture whether risk stress is accelerating or easing. A falling/non-rising VIX is typically more supportive for crypto exposure.
selected_orientation_note: Lower values are favourable, matching the stress-easing interpretation.
